tmp:1649: mevatlim ha-teva — the action of nullifying/overriding nature's determinism through Jewish prayer, countering the philosophers' claim that nature ('mother of all life') is fixed
tmp:1650: chai birkhaan — the eighteen (chai=18) blessings of the Amidah prayer (excluding birkat ha-minim), whose recital nullifies nature ('mother of all life') and subdues heretics
tmp:1651: seeing the tzaddik — the first of three modes of attachment to the tzaddik (per Isaiah 30:20 'your eyes shall see your Teacher'), whose gaze nullifies bad traits from the mineral/vegetative elements (sadness and evil desires)
tmp:1652: gazing upon temunat Hashem — beholding the 'image of God,' i.e. the prophetic anthropomorphic likenesses (Compassionate, Gracious, etc.), attained through clapping palm against palm in prayer
tmp:1653: playing an instrument by hand — the musician's hand-motion on the instrument that sifts the good spirit (ruach of prophecy/joy) from the evil melancholy spirit, subduing the imaginative faculty (as David's playing for Saul)
tmp:1656: magdilim otah — raising/growing the newborn soul (nefesh) through love (ahavah), the 'great hand' (yad ha-gedolah), following its birth through fear
tmp:1658: chut shel chesed — the 'thread of lovingkindness' drawn upon a person (Abrahamic chesed of 'he planted an eshel'), a protective kabbalistic emanation shielding from the serpent
tmp:1659: protection from the serpent — the shielding effect of the thread of chesed (Abraham's aspect, the tree in the Maharsha's parable) that guards a person from the serpent of lust/evil
tmp:1660: burning heart-heat for God — the fervor of the heart aflame toward Hashem, whose fire-nature expels the spirit of impurity (as fire expels air)
tmp:1661: chamimut ha-lev — the heart's heat/fervor as a fire-element force that drives out the impure spirit, analogized to gunpowder's ignition expelling air
tmp:1663: speaking more with the Rebbe — the increased personal converse with one's master that flows from holy boldness (azut di-kedushah), the measure of one's closeness to the tzaddik
tmp:1666: MaL (מל) — the word 'circumcised' from ChaShMaL (chash-mal), gematria 70, whose cutting nullifies the bonfire of the seventy stars; circumcision as tikkun ha-brit
tmp:1668: birthing the mochin — the Shekhinah's 'giving birth' to the withdrawn mentalities: one's cry in prayer/Torah, like a laboring woman's cry, brings the mochin out of their gestational concealment
tmp:1669: molid — begetting/procreating, dependent on the letter heh ('hei lakhem zera') and on da'at ('a minor cannot beget'); why Abraham and Sarah bore children only upon receiving the heh
tmp:1670: the two hands — yad ha-gedolah (great hand = love, which raises the soul) and yad ha-chazakah (strong hand = fear, which births it), as in 'in Your hand is power and might... to make great'
tmp:1671: birthing and raising the soul clothed in Kavod — the twofold action (via fear and love, the two divine hands) of begetting and then growing the nefesh that is garbed in the King of Glory/Malkhut
tmp:1672: galgalei ha-rakia — the celestial spheres/star-wheels of the firmament that determine terrestrial conditions (roads, deserts, settlement) and mark time; cause of travelers' sufferings
tmp:1673: mo'ed — 'appointed time/festival' in Lamentations 1:4 read as the celestial spheres by which time is reckoned ('roads of Zion mourn without comers to the mo'ed')
tmp:1674: charity's efficacy against lustful thoughts — tzedakah as a segulah that protects from hirhurei ni'uf (adulterous fantasies), though one may not rely on it to mingle with women
tmp:1675: faith in the tzaddik's words — the believers' emunah in what the tzaddik says, which is itself the agency that causes his latent wonders (moftim) to become revealed
tmp:1676: moftim — wonders/miracles of the tzaddikim, revealed publicly (as in the Kaiser's lands) only where the populace has faith in the tzaddik's words
tmp:1678: 'more bitter than death is the woman' — Ecclesiastes 7:26 applied to livelihood earned in sorrow (parnasah = 'woman'), the bitter mode of sustenance needing sweetening
tmp:1679: siftotayikh — 'your lips' (Song of Songs), symbolizing the bringing of the intellect from potential into actuality (mi-ko'ach el ha-po'al) through speech
tmp:1680: extracting her from the kelipot — tzedakah's rescue of the soul/Nukva ('her feet go down to death') from among the husks that suck her light and constrict one's sustenance; 'charity saves from death'
tmp:1681: movement generating fervor for God — how thought-to-thought motion in contemplating God's greatness 'brings down' heat, setting the heart aflame, like motion melting wax on an arrow
tmp:1682: power of prayer-in-awe — the force drawn from tefillah performed with yirah (fear of God, 'my house'), by which the tzaddik rules ('You shall be over my house')
tmp:1683: bringing down shefa and magnifying His kingship — the tzaddik's ruling in fear of God draws divine abundance into the world and enlarges God's Malkhut ('by your mouth all my people shall be sustained')
tmp:1684: moshel — 'ruler,' the meaning of dabar ('one leader for a generation'); Malkhut as leadership/dominion restored to God via verbal confession before a Torah scholar
tmp:1685: atzirut — constipation/retention as the bodily figure of motarot (waste/superfluities); Doeg's Torah study 'detained before Hashem' derived from this excremental aspect, yielding crooked judgment
tmp:1689: mizbe'ach be-chelko shel toref — the altar standing in the territory of the 'predator' (Benjamin, per Yaakov's blessing); the completeness of the altar whose flaw empowers idolatry, rectified through converts
tmp:1692: 'Reprove a wise man and he will love you' (Proverbs 9:8) — verse assigned to the brain-aspect of the ears (udnin), i.e. hearing the words of the wise
tmp:1693: 'The beginning of wisdom is fear of the Lord' (Psalms 111:10) — verse assigned to the brain-aspect of the nose (chotem), the moach manifest in smell/awe
tmp:1694: 'And the eyes of both were opened' (Genesis 3:7) — verse assigned to the brain-aspect of the eyes (aynin), the moach manifest in sight
tmp:1695: 'The beginning of Your word is truth' (Psalms 119:160) — verse assigned to the brain-aspect of the mouth (peh), the moach manifest in speech
tmp:1696: heart's desire revealed in the hands — the cheshek of the heart becoming manifest through the hands ('ki vi' = 42 = 3×yad), i.e. the basis of clapping the palms in prayer
tmp:1697: tevel (world) — gematria 432 = 2×216 (right hand 72 subsuming 3×72=216 plus left hand 216), the cosmos-name signifying the union of right and left in hand-clapping
tmp:1698: kupah shel sheratzim — the 'basket of vermin hanging behind him' (Yoma 22b): a discrediting blemish required of a communal leader so he not grow arrogant
tmp:1699: self-abnegation of the leader — holding oneself as 'mah,' naught and nothing (ayin), the humility stance that protects the generation's leaders from arrogance
tmp:1703: Shem Yah (יה) — the divine Name Yah, aspect of the mochin (mentalities), by which Scripture testifies to Israel's purity ('tribes of Yah,' the added heh/yud of ha-Chanokhi)
tmp:1705: kavanah — the prayer-intention/mental focus aroused by the voice ('the voice arouses the kavanah'), identified with the mochin birthed through crying out
